name: Potions Galore
storyline:
Oh no. Your potion sorting ritual backfired disastrously! Now every single one of the 2979 potion bottles on the shelves of your master, the Grand Alchemist Joseph Grand’Oeur are scattered all over the place. With your spells spent, you have to use your deductive skills, the shelves’ signage and the potions’ labels and descriptions to tidy up the mess you made!

You are the Apprentice, working under the Grand Alchemist. Due to your lazyness, now you have to manually shelve everything. No magic. No powerups. Just hard work and book reading. Like all the other Apprentice Alchemists in fantasy history!
summary: Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize 2500+ potion bottles in their respective shelves. Read about every unique set in the Potion Encyclopedia, deduce the correct placement and tidy up the mess you made when your sorting ritual failed!
